interpretation: The public Humble arrival chronology cannot satisfy the predeclared minimum sample-size gate. The maximum structurally possible matched panel is 64 rows, less than half of the frozen 150-row requirement. The arrival-memory hypothesis is therefore terminated as non-estimable rather than rescued by lowering the threshold after inspecting data availability.

invalid_or_superseded_execution.rule: Do not inspect or use scientific coefficients from this pre-gate workflow if it later executes; the structural estimability gate supersedes it.

next_gate: Search for genuine individual-level Palmer band/resight or other movement/return data. Do not repurpose the underpowered arrival panel by changing the frozen minimum-row rule.
